items.headline: Colandrea's two TD passes and stout defense lifts unbeaten Nebraska past Michigan State, 31-13
items.description: — Anthony Colandrea passed for 212 yards and two first-half touchdowns as undefeated Nebraska pulled away to a 31-13 win over mistake-prone Michigan State in the Big Ten opener for both teams on Saturday.
